```lean
theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} : Monotone f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄ (ha : a ∉ s), f s ≤ f (Finset.cons a s ha) := by
  split
  · intro h
    intros s a ha
    have : a ∉ Finset.cons a s ha := by contradiction ha
    exact h (Finset.cons a s ha) s (Finset.mem_cons_self _ ha)
  · intro h
    intros a b hab
    have : b ∈ Finset.cons a (Finset.singleton b) (by simp [hab]) :=
      Finset.mem_cons.2 ⟨hab, Finset.mem_singleton_self _⟩
    exact h (Finset.cons a (Finset.singleton b) (by simp [hab])) (Finset.singleton b) this
```
